hits.name: Chambray Shirtdress
hits.description: The Chambray Shirtdress in moss green is a versatile cotton staple featuring patch pockets and a fold-back collar that transitions seamlessly from city streets to mountain trails. Wrinkle-resistant and designed with a relaxed fit, this travel-friendly layering piece is your go-to for spontaneous road trips and outdoor adventures.
